note: Default rates per minute, [low, high] per bracket. Researched 2026-11-24 where 'basis' says so; anything marked PLACEHOLDER is unresearched. Tune with sessions, /xp rate, or data/rates/overrides.json.

sources.userAnswers: Tuning answers from the bot owner, 2026-11-24
sources.wikiFarming: hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Farming: Farming XP is per crop block broken (+4 most crops, +2 sugar cane/cactus, +6 mushrooms); Farming Fortune multiplies drops, not XP
sources.wikiMining: hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Mining: Mining XP per block (cobblestone +1, coal/iron +5, diamond +10, mithril +45, gemstone +70, titanium +100)
sources.farmingSpeed: totalcalchub farming calculator: ~20 blocks/sec typical for efficient farming, up to ~23
sources.wikiRevenant: hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Revenant_Horror: Slayer XP per tier 5/25/100/500/1,500; each tier needs the previous one defeated; tier V needs Zombie Slayer VII
sources.wikiDungeonScore: hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Dungeon_Score: Speed time limits F1-3 10 min, F4 12, F5 10, F6 12, F7 14; M1-5 8, M6 10, M7 14
sources.wikiFloors: hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki floor pages: base XP F1 80 (M1 10k), F5 2,400, F7 30k; first 5 completions a day +40% Catacombs XP
sources.skykingsCombat: SkyKings combat XP guide (older): Endermen ~100-200k/h until ~Combat 20; T3 Revenants 600-700k/h; F6 golem rushing 0.8-1.4M/h; ghosts up to 900k/h
sources.wikiForagingNerf: hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki Changelog/2026/July_22/Alpha: Fig Foraging XP lowered from 1,000 to 100
sources.wikiExperiments: hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Experiments: 3 charges per day; enchanting table/anvil XP capped at 500k/day

bestiary.basis: Common mobs (NEU kill bracket 1). Late: 50-100/min with AoE clears (user answers 2026-11-24). Early and mid are estimates; spawn caps limit it.
bestiary.scaleNote: Other NEU kill brackets scale by their tier-10 kill threshold relative to bracket 1, so each tier takes roughly the same time

bestiaryMilestone.basis: PLACEHOLDER: one milestone is 10 family tiers

FARMING.basis: blocks/sec x (1 + fortune/100): early ~8 bps, <100 fortune; mid ~15 bps, ~300 fortune; late ~20 bps, ~1,400 fortune (farmingSpeed, wikiFarming)

MINING.basis: early ~1.5 blocks/sec cobblestone/coal with low fortune; mid ~0.7 mithril/sec x ~3; late ~2 gemstones/sec x ~10 (estimate)

COMBAT.basis: kills/min x 1-3 drops: single target early, AoE weapons clear 50-100+ mobs/min later (estimate)

FORAGING.basis: logs/min: single logs early, multi-log axes mid, tree-felling late (estimate)

ANIMAL.basis: farm animals killed/min x 1-3 drops (estimate); these are FARMING collections but come from killing mobs, not harvesting crops

farming.basis: mid 300-600k/h, late 0.8-1.5M/h incl. pests and visitors (user answers 2026-11-24); early from ~8 blocks/sec x 4 XP (wikiFarming, farmingSpeed)

mining.basis: coal/iron/gold (+5-6) ~1-2 blocks/sec early; mithril +45 ~0.7/sec mid; gemstones +70 ~2/sec with wisdom late (wikiMining)

combat.basis: Endermen 100-200k/h early; T3 Revenants 600-700k/h mid; golem rushing/ghosts 0.8-1.4M/h late (skykingsCombat)

foraging.basis: 60-100k / 200-300k / 0.5-1M per hour after the July 2026 Fig nerf (user answers 2026-11-24, wikiForagingNerf)

enchanting.basis: experiments: 3 charges/day, each = Chronomatron + Ultrasequencer + Superpairs at the best tier your level allows (early ~50-97k/game, mid ~207-530k, late ~530-630k incl. Metaphysical at 50), done in ~10 min/day (user answers 2026-11-24, wikiExperiments). Per active minute: a long goal spans many days of 10 minutes. Bought extra games (Bits) not counted.

alchemy.basis: PLACEHOLDER: players rarely level this outside the Derpy mayor, who doubles skill XP; mayor bonuses are not modelled (user answers 2026-11-24)

carpentry.basis: PLACEHOLDER: players rarely level this outside the Derpy mayor, who doubles skill XP; mayor bonuses are not modelled (user answers 2026-11-24)

taming.basis: PLACEHOLDER: players rarely level this outside the Derpy mayor, who doubles skill XP; mayor bonuses are not modelled (user answers 2026-11-24)

hunting.basis: PLACEHOLDER: players rarely level this outside the Derpy mayor, who doubles skill XP; mayor bonuses are not modelled (user answers 2026-11-24)

slayerXp.basis: tier XP / minutes per boss incl. spawning. Late (slayer 8+): T5 Revenant is a one-tap with ~15 s spawns, under a minute end to end, so 1,500-2,000 slayer XP/min (user answers 2026-11-24). Mid: T4 (500 XP) ~1.5-3 min. Early: T3 (100 XP) ~2-4 min. Other bosses are scaled from Revenant (estimate).
slayerXp.byBossNote: Sven, Voidgloom and Inferno top out at tier IV (500 XP); Riftstalker gives 10/25/60/120/150 (NEU leveling.json)

slayerBoss.basis: first kill of a tier: spawn quest plus fight; ~1 min late (one-tap, ~15 s spawn, user answers 2026-11-24), 2-5 min mid, 5-10 min early

catacombsXp.basis: XP per run / run time. Late (C45+): M7 ~500k XP with usual boosts in ~4-4.5 min at C50 (user answers 2026-11-24) = ~110-125k/min, with slower runs below that. Mid (C30-44): M5-M6 (~70-100k base x1.5) at 6-8 min. Early (<C30): F5 (2,400) to F7 (30k x1.4) at 8-12 min (wikiFloors)

classXp.basis: the class you play earns about the run's Catacombs XP; other classes get much less, so this assumes you play that class

floors.basis: minutes per run, then runs/min = 1/minutes. Late (C45+): M7 ~4-4.5 min (user answers 2026-11-24), other floors faster. Mid is about the Speed time limit; early is over it (wikiDungeonScore)

minionNote: estimate: material needs roughly double per tier (~80 base items for I up to ~160k for XII), gathered at 300-1,500 items/min, plus 1-2 min to craft
